get_model_complexity_info: get model complexity info by running a forward pass and counting FLOPs and parameters
flops_to_string: convert a raw FLOPs count into a human-readable string with units like GMac or MMac
params_to_string: convert a parameter count into a human-readable string with units like M or k
print_model_with_flops: print a model repr showing per-layer FLOPs, parameter counts, and percentages
add_flops_counting_methods: add FLOPs counting methods to a PyTorch model for benchmarking
